# UnSlopIt

> UnSlopIt humanizes AI-written text. It strips the tells that give AI away — buzzwords, stock framings, chatbot sign-offs, false balance — and returns a clean draft plus a red-pen list of every change, while keeping your meaning and facts intact. Instant AI editing; a human-editing option is on the way.

## Pages

- [Home](https://unslopit.ai/): Paste an AI draft and get a de-slopped version. Choose edit strength (light, medium, full), optionally add a natural human typo, and see both a redline and a clean result with a change list.
- [What is AI slop?](https://unslopit.ai/learn): Defines AI slop and lists the full taxonomy of tells the editor removes — 13 categories, each with examples — plus an FAQ.
- [About](https://unslopit.ai/about): What UnSlopIt does, and how the free tier works.

## Notes

- Positioning: the goal is writing people want to read, not evading AI detectors.
- This file is a map, not a mirror; it's updated as new taxonomy and guide pages ship.
